text:
incident-bot: [P2] dedpool node lost heartbeat: pool=quartz-ded node=gpu-07 zone=us-west-2 tenant=quartz-enterprise(vpc-987)
Ash: taking oncall. paging infra + hw-ops. @Jon @Lee
Jon: grabbing telemetry now. NVMe latency jumped then BMC stopped responding. isolating workloads from gpu-07.
Lee: prepping remote power-cycle and spare GPU. if power-cycle fails, need on-site swap. ETA 30m for tech.
Maya: recommend live-migrate active sessions off gpu-07 before drain. will kick reroute and warm caches on fallback pool.
Ash: starting graceful drain
```
rictl node drain --pool quartz-ded --node gpu-07 --grace 45s --evict-tenant quartz-enterprise
```
Ash: drain in progress. 9/27 sessions moved. small tail spikes for enterprise routes.
Emma: notifying customer privately: "We've isolated the affected node and are migrating sessions to a fallback. You may see brief latency blips under 4s. Will update in 20m." cc @Ben
Ben: acknowledged. ask CS to capture exact error rates and whether any API 5xxs occurred. we may need to estimate SLA exposure.
Maya: updating route policy for new requests to fallback-quantized model
```
rictl route update --tenant quartz-enterprise --from redwood/rt-large --to redwood/rt-quant-8bit --policy immediate
```
Maya: new requests now landing on quartz-fallback. KV cache warmup in progress; expect N tokens cache writes.
Jon: pulled kernel logs: "[kernel] PCIe AER: device reset recovered" then repeated. I'm suspecting intermittent PCIe fabric errors leading to device hang. tagging infra-hw for sweep.
Lee: remote cycle didn't clear fault. prepping RMA and permanent quarantine of gpu-07. Reserving spare GPU now. ETA RMA swap 5hr. If customer impact escalates, we can schedule emergency hot-swap.
Ash: sessions fully migrated: 27/27. scheduler marked gpu-07 quarantined.
Ravi: enabling autoscale on quartz-fallback to absorb traffic.
```
rictl autoscale set --pool quartz-fallback --min-instances 6 --max-instances 40
```
Emma: customer confirms degraded tails but functionality intact. opened CS ticket CS-5821 and linked incident.
Ben: collect exact window of impact and any retries. we'll prepare enterprise incident summary.
Maya: logs show no 5xxs to tenant endpoints; retries were served by fallback within 1-3s. saving traces for postmortem.
Jon: follow-ups: firmware check across pool, run PCIe fabric health sweep, review NVMe SMART history. Filing INF-904.
Lee: RMA initiated, spare staged. will update ETA when tech confirms on-site pickup.
Ash: creating incident IN-2026-4071. will close thread when RMA scheduled and CS confirmation logged. updating in 30m or earlier. :white_check_mark:
